title: Give review-epic a structured verdict; a NOT READY review answered DONE_WITH_CONCERNS closes and releases the close-out
body: ticfac.job-result.review-epic.v1 has no review-verdict field. rolejob.go holds a role tick only on needsHuman (BLOCKED/NEEDS_CONTEXT, dispatch.go:2153), so pxc attempt 9's NOT READY answer was being closed (seq 121) and only the findings hold stopped the close-out. decisions/1.json records verdict 'ready-to-merge' (collect vocabulary) beside a NOT READY summary. Decide whether NOT READY holds the close-out or is carried to the PR, and name the field so the record cannot be read as an approval.
